chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'What is the right of God upon His creation?'
So he said: 'That they say what they know, and that they refrain from what they do not know.'
So when they do that, they have indeed fulfilled God's right.

key_terms.أَدَّوْا: they fulfilled, they discharged (a due obligation)
key_terms.حَقُّ: right, due obligation owed by the creature to God
key_terms.يَكُفُّوا: they refrain, they abstain (from speaking without knowledge)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq (AS) say is God's right upon His creation in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Hisham ibn Salim poses a foundational question to Imam al-Sadiq (AS): what is God's foremost right upon His creatures? The Imam's answer is epistemological in character — the paramount obligation to God is speaking only from verified knowledge and maintaining disciplined silence about what lies beyond one's ken. This teaching situated God's 'right' not in ritual performance but in intellectual and moral integrity, a recurring concern in the early chapters of al-Kafi dedicated to 'ilm.
word_analysis: they have fulfilled / they have paid
